about: Local models offered by Atollo (llm/catalog.rs, D-151): GGUF files from Hugging Face at a fixed commit, each with its SHA-256 (the lfs.oid of the Hugging Face API) and size in bytes. A model in several parts lists all of them, the first one first: the parts of Qwen2.5-Coder 7B stay under 4 GiB and fit a FAT32 drive. ctx: the context window the server gives it; ramGb: the memory it needs with that context, about; tools: it calls tools (the agents need it); desc: Italian, translated by tauri/i18n/catalog.json.
